clusters.name: The move west to Sorrel Valley
clusters.reason: The family moved from Millbrook to Sorrel Valley in March 1952; over the next eighteen months June, Walter, Glen, Faye and Roy shifted, and Walter's brother Harlan stopped writing.

clusters.name: Losing the orchard
clusters.reason: The frost and the bank's call on the loan came in May 1968; Walter's drinking, his quarrel with Glen, Marian taking over the money, Carl's asthma, Nora's bedwetting and Ida's heart trouble came within the next year and a half.

clusters.name: Glen's layoff at the cannery
clusters.reason: Glen lost his job in February 1975; within the year he sat at home out of work, he and Marian fought, she took a second job, and Nora, Carl, Tess and Walter each shifted.

clusters.name: Wilma moving in
clusters.reason: Wilma moved into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990; over the next eighteen months Nora clashed with her, Sam pulled back from Nora and took his mother's side, and Owen had tantrums, until Wilma took a flat in town in June 1991.

declined.reason: Five days of trouble around the wildfire evacuation in August 1994 that passed once the family was home: an acute episode, not a period.
Tess's drinking and the worry around it in 1996 and 1997 come with no change in who is in the family on a known date, so this time is held as a hypothesis.
